attempted_claim: Let p=3 and let W=S/9 be the 3-local mod-9 Moore spectrum with BP_*W=BP_*/9. Compute the Adams-Novikov E_2=Ext_{BP_*BP}(BP_*,BP_*/9) ledger for 0<=s<=3 and 28<=t-s<=46 with explicit cobar representatives, the v_0-Bockstein connecting map from the Ext over BP_*/3 ledger, and all 3-torsion relations. Let b be the class lifting beta_{3/3} to this window. Prove either that the Adams-Novikov d_5(b) is zero with b surviving to E_6, or that d_5(b) equals a specified nonzero 3-torsion class in bidegree (s=7,t-s=45) with explicit cobar formula not in the Miller-Ravenel-Wilson, Shimomura, or Wang tables, and prove via Moss convergence with crossing-differential check which element of the stable Toda bracket <9, alpha_1, b-hat> in pi_*(W) is detected, with bracket degrees, strict-definedness, and indeterminacy named; a complete answer is the E_2 table plus the proved d_5 alternative plus the proved bracket coset.
claim_type: E2 ledger plus d5 alternative and Toda-bracket detection
decisive_failure: The target as literally specified is dimensionally inconsistent: the nonzero d5 horn demands a class twelve stems above any differential image of the beta_{3/3} lift, so no E2 ledger computation or Moss convergence argument within this pass could complete it. A corrected restatement with landing bidegree (7,33) would require a fresh full investigation beyond the remaining clock.
